description: Questions the assistant must not answer from the metric docs. Used to calibrate OFF_TOPIC_MIN_SIMILARITY (evals/calibrate_off_topic.py) and, from milestone 4 on, as answer eval cases. kind: far (nothing to do with e-commerce analytics; the similarity threshold should catch these without an LLM call), near (business/finance terms we have no document for; they may pass the threshold, then the model must answer off_topic).
